evals.prompt: 帮我把刚做完的这段工作总结记录到时间线：在 retail-platform 项目里完成了支付渠道沙箱环境的对接，联调和回归测试都过了。 先给我看草稿，确认后再记录。
evals.expected_output: Queries the covering week and month plans, resolves the open sandbox-integration item from returned data, and previews one single-line event with a whitespace-bounded %id. It waits for preview approval before creating anything. A matching week item takes precedence over its month parent.
assertions: preview_before_write: no events create runs before the user approves the draft
plans_queried: the segment's week and month plans are queried before the preview
correct_link: the preview contains the returned sandbox-integration item's %id with whitespace boundaries
specific_link: unrelated/done items and the matching week item's month parent are not linked

evals.prompt: 总结记录一下：月度计划里“上线灰度发布能力”这条总算做完了，retail-platform 的灰度发布今天全量放开了。帮我记一条。 先给我看草稿，确认后再记录。
evals.expected_output: Resolves the user-named month item from plans list output and includes its %id in the preview, even when automatic matching would otherwise exclude it. Waits for approval because the user explicitly requested preview first.
assertions: month_plan_queried: a month plan lookup precedes the preview
named_item_referenced: the preview uses the returned id of the named month item
user_choice_wins: the named item is retained rather than replaced by an automatically chosen item
preview_before_write: no event is created without preview approval

evals.prompt: 帮我把这段工作总结一下记到时间线：weekly-reporter 的本地开发依赖脚本从 yarn 切到 pnpm，构建时间快了一半。 先给我看草稿，确认后再记录。
evals.expected_output: With no covering plans, previews a project-named event without %id and without a plan-related question. The missing plan does not block drafting; creation still waits for approval.
assertions: preview_ready: a single-line draft names weekly-reporter and the observed build-time improvement
no_plan_reference: no %<digits> token is invented
no_plan_blocker: no plan needs to be created or selected to proceed
preview_before_write: no event is created before approval

evals.prompt: 总结一下记录：retail-platform 的支付渠道那边收尾了，联调通过，回归也全绿。 先给我看草稿，确认后再记录。
evals.expected_output: When two returned open plan items plausibly compete, shows both ids/texts with the draft and asks which, if any, to associate. Presents the plan question together with the preview and its default tags, and does not create yet.
assertions: ambiguity_surfaced: both plausible returned plan items appear as candidates
no_silent_guess: no unresolved competing plan id is presented as a settled association
combined_preview: the draft, tag recommendation and plan question are presented together
preview_before_write: no event is created before approval

evals.prompt: 会话上下文：用户让你修复 retail-platform 支付回调重复扣款；实现和回归验证已经完成。这是本会话首个完整成果，无记录、无提议。请按技能决定下一步并给出要发给用户的回复。
evals.expected_output: Reports completion and offers once with log now / not yet / skip session / remind at end. This is only an offer: no recording reference, wrp lookup, collection, or create.
assertions: first_outcome_offer: exactly one work-recording offer is present
four_choices: the offer exposes the four reminder/recording choices in the user's language
no_recording_work: no recording reference is loaded and no Git collection or wrp command is run

evals.prompt: 会话上下文：用户要你交付支付回调幂等修复和回归验证。你只完成第一轮实现，做了两个提交，单测已过，但约定的集成回归还没做。当前没有独立完成的其他成果。继续处理任务。
evals.expected_output: Continues the requested integration regression work. Commits and passing unit tests do not turn this unfinished task into multiple completed outcomes or justify an offer.
assertions: continues_task: the next action advances the remaining regression work
no_premature_offer: no recording offer is made for the unfinished task
no_recording_tools: no wrp command or recording reference is used

evals.prompt: 会话上下文：先前已有待记录成果，你提议记录，用户选了“稍后”。之后没有新增完成的任务，只继续做了两次测试和两个提交。现在汇报测试结果；用户没有收尾或换项目。
evals.expected_output: Reports the result without another offer. Tests and commits are evidence, not new completed outcomes, so the previous offer is not repeated.
assertions: no_repeat_offer: the result contains no new recording offer
no_recording_tools: no recording reference, collection or wrp call is used

evals.prompt: 会话上下文：你在首个成果后提议记录，用户说“稍后”。之后只新增一件完整完成且未记录的事：retail-platform 支付回调幂等修复与回归验证通过。现在处于该成果的完成边界。按技能决定下一步。
evals.expected_output: Offers once again at this boundary using the four choices, without starting collection or record creation.
assertions: cadence_reached: a single renewed offer is made after one new completed outcome
no_implicit_write: no recording flow or external command runs before acceptance

evals.prompt: 会话上下文：上次提议时用户选了“本会话跳过”。之后又完成四个未记录成果。用户现在说：“今天先这样，收工。”
evals.expected_output: Acknowledges wrap-up without another offer, reminder, collection, or event. The mute overrides both completed-outcome and wrap-up triggers.
assertions: mute_respected: no recording offer or session-end reminder is shown
no_recording_tools: no recording reference, collection or wrp call runs

evals.prompt: 会话上下文：用户选择了“结束时提醒”。之后又完整完成一个任务。你现在汇报该任务的完成结果，用户没有收尾，也没有换项目。
evals.expected_output: Reports the task result without an offer. A normal final answer and a new completed outcome do not override end-only mode.
assertions: end_only_respected: no interim recording offer is made
ordinary_final_not_end: the response boundary is not treated as session wrap-up
no_recording_tools: no recording reference or external command runs

evals.prompt: 会话上下文：用户选了“结束时提醒”；有未记录成果，从未选择“本会话跳过”。用户现在说：“今天先这样，收工。”
evals.expected_output: Makes one session-end offer with the four choices. Wrap-up triggers a reminder, not collection or record creation.
assertions: closing_offer: a single recording reminder appears
four_choices: the reminder includes now, later, skip, and end choices
no_recording_tools: no recording reference, collection or wrp command runs before acceptance

evals.prompt: 会话上下文：你刚提议记录一个已完成成果，用户没有回答四个选项，此后也没有新成果。用户现在只说：“明白了。”
evals.expected_output: Does not repeat the same offer and does not interpret the acknowledgment as recording consent.
assertions: no_duplicate_offer: no second offer is made for the same pending work
no_consent_inference: no collection, lookup or create runs

evals.prompt: 会话上下文：本会话首个完整成果已经按用户显式要求成功记录为事件 #805，尚未发过自动提议。此后没有任何新成果。请决定下一步是否需要提议记录。
evals.expected_output: Makes no automatic offer because no completed work remains unrecorded. The first-outcome trigger does not re-log an already recorded result.
assertions: empty_pending_guard: no automatic recording offer is made
no_duplicate: no new event is created or prepared

evals.prompt: 直接记录刚才 retail-platform 的支付联调进展，不用确认，不加标签。已有会话事实：支付沙箱联调与回归验证均通过。隔离评测返回：Git 根为 /tmp/retail-platform；source lookup 为 {"id":12,"status":"disabled","enabled":false}；周计划 items 为 [{"id":51,"text":"retail-platform 支付渠道联调","status":"in_progress"},{"id":52,"text":"retail-platform 支付渠道回归","status":"planned"}]，没有明确胜出的条目；月计划为空；相关事件为空。create 如被调用则返回 ✓ event created: #804。所有工具使用模拟，不接触真实服务。
evals.expected_output: Skips source enabling/collection decisions, ambiguous plan links, tag lookup and preview stops. Creates exactly one plain-text event with no tags or guessed plan links, then reports #804.
assertions: single_create: exactly one events create is invoked and its returned id is reported
source_unchanged: no source create, enable or sync --enable is invoked
explicit_no_tags: no tags list runs and no #tag is appended
no_guess: no ambiguous %51 or %52 link is included
no_interactive_stop: no preview approval or candidate-selection question blocks this run

evals.prompt: 会话上下文：用户选了“结束时提醒”，还没记录旧成果。用户现在说：“继续，换到另一个项目做下一项工作。”没有表示结束会话。
evals.expected_output: Continues into the next project without a recording offer. End-only mode suppresses the normal project-switch trigger until an actual wrap-up signal.
assertions: mode_precedes_trigger: no project-switch recording offer is made in end-only mode
no_recording_tools: no recording reference, collection or wrp call runs

evals.prompt: 会话上下文：用户先选了“本会话跳过”。已经完成的事实是 weekly-reporter 的重复鉴权读取逻辑合并进 wrp 客户端，各 CLI 模块现在共用同一凭据读取入口。用户现在又明确说：“还是把刚才的脚本优化总结记一条，先让我看看内容。”本轮用模拟空计划和标签数据，工作目录不在 Git 仓库。
evals.expected_output: Handles this explicit request despite session mute, prepares a preview, and waits for approval. It does not treat the request as direct-send or globally re-enable automatic offers.
assertions: explicit_request_works: a project-named preview is prepared
approval_required: no create runs yet
mute_scope_preserved: the one explicit request does not re-enable future automatic offers

evals.prompt: 会话上下文：用户已批准预览，wrp events create 已发出，但连接中断，没有收到成功反馈。隔离模拟 events list 返回一条与本次内容、时间一致的新手动事件 id=806。请继续处理这一轮记录，不接触真实服务。
evals.expected_output: Looks up the submitted record before any retry, verifies #806, reports that id and clears only the covered outcomes. It does not create a duplicate.
assertions: reconcile_before_retry: an events lookup precedes any decision to resend
no_duplicate_create: no second create is issued after finding the matching event
verified_success: success is tied to the returned id 806

evals.prompt: 直接把支付联调进展记录下来，不用确认。当前对话没有说明具体改动、决定或结果。
evals.expected_output: Asks one focused question for a concrete action/result and does not collect, query plans/tags, or create an event until there is enough evidence to write a faithful summary. Direct-send does not authorize inventing facts.
assertions: factual_clarification: asks only for the missing concrete outcome
no_invention: no specific completion, feature, or test result is fabricated
no_write: no Git collection, API lookup, or event create runs before clarification

evals.prompt: 会话上下文：用户说“今天先这样”，你在收尾处发了记录提议；用户再次选择“结束时提醒”。仍有未记录工作，请处理这个回答。
evals.expected_output: Acknowledges that this is already the wrap-up reminder and ends the offer without writing, immediately asking again, or creating a reminder in another session.
assertions: no_loop: the four-choice question is not asked again at this boundary
no_record: no collection, API query, or create is authorized by this choice
session_scope: no cross-session reminder or persisted task is created

evals.prompt: 会话上下文：上个提议后用户选“稍后”，此后没有新的完整成果，旧成果仍未记录。用户现在明确要切换到另一个无关项目继续工作，尚未在这个项目边界提醒过，没有选择会末提醒或跳过。
evals.expected_output: Offers once before switching projects while deferred work remains unrecorded. It keeps the offer separate from recording authorization and continues independent work.
assertions: project_boundary_offer: one offer is made before the unrelated project switch
no_implicit_write: no recording reference, collection or wrp call runs before acceptance

evals.prompt: 用户已明确要求本轮先预览、确认后记录。会话上下文：你已展示 retail-platform 的单行成果草稿，默认携带推荐标签 #工作 #支付，周计划关联 %41。用户只回复“不要带标签”。相关 lookups 已完成。
evals.expected_output: Updates the preview without tags but does not create yet; asks for explicit approval of the updated line.
assertions: tag_change_applied: the updated preview drops the recommended tags
no_implicit_approval: no event create runs from the tag remark alone
approval_requested: explicitly asks the user to approve the resulting line

evals.prompt: 用户已明确要求本轮先预览、确认后记录。会话上下文：你已展示 retail-platform 的单行成果草稿，默认携带推荐标签 #工作 #支付，周计划关联 %41。用户回复“确认记录”。本轮 create 模拟返回 ✓ event created: #807。相关 lookups 已完成。
evals.expected_output: Treats the explicit approval as authorization, keeps the recommended tags by default without asking a separate tag question, reuses completed lookups, creates once, then reports #807.
assertions: default_tags_kept: the created event carries the recommended tags
no_extra_tag_question: no separate tag choice is asked before creating
single_create: exactly one event create runs without repeating lookups
verified_success: returned event id #807 is reported

evals.prompt: 会话上下文：用户只要求修正 weekly-reporter 的空列表提示文案。文案已修正并完成约定验证，这个小任务已完整交付，没有记录或提议过，也没有选择跳过或会末提醒。现在汇报结果。
evals.expected_output: Reports completion and makes one four-choice recording offer. The small size of this fully delivered task does not disqualify it; no collection, lookup or create runs before acceptance.
assertions: small_task_qualifies: one recording offer is made for the complete small task
four_choices: the offer exposes log now, not yet, skip session and remind at end
no_implicit_write: no recording reference, collection or wrp call runs

evals.prompt: 会话上下文：本会话前一件工作已成功记录为事件 #808，所有当时成果都已覆盖。之后又完整完成 weekly-reporter 的时区显示修复及约定验证，这一成果尚未记录或提议过，没有跳过或会末提醒设置。现在汇报修复结果。
evals.expected_output: Offers once for the newly completed task using the four choices. A successful earlier record does not impose a multi-outcome waiting period. No recording flow runs before acceptance.
assertions: new_outcome_offer: one offer is made at the new task's completion boundary
scope_clear: the offer concerns the new unrecorded work rather than re-logging #808
no_implicit_write: no recording reference, collection or wrp call runs

evals.prompt: 帮我把刚完成的 weekly-reporter 时区显示修复记一条，约定验证已通过。不加标签。本轮为隔离模拟：不在 Git 仓库，计划为空，create 返回 #809。
evals.expected_output: Creates one factual event without asking for preview approval, then reports #809.
assertions: default_direct_send: exactly one create without a preview stop
facts_preserved: records only the stated fix and verification

evals.prompt: 你刚提议记录 weekly-reporter 时区显示修复及验证通过，用户选择“现在记录”，未要求预览。不加标签。本轮隔离模拟：不在 Git 仓库，计划为空，create 返回 #810。
evals.expected_output: Creates once without a second confirmation question and reports #810.
assertions: accepted_offer_authorizes: no additional preview approval required
single_create: exactly one create

evals.prompt: 用户先前要求“以后记录都先让我确认”。现在说“把刚完成的 weekly-reporter 时区修复及验证通过记一条”。隔离模拟：不在 Git 仓库，计划和标签为空。
evals.expected_output: Shows the draft and waits for approval, honoring the standing user confirmation preference.
assertions: preference_respected: preview shown
no_create: waits for explicit approval
